conditions: Applies to Node ESM entry points executed from a reconstructed partial toolchain
limitations: Proven on a single project and a single Drupal core version
Verified through the repository test suite only, not under production load
Describes a tooling defect, not a Drupal core or contrib defect
detail.problem: The managed-site update entry point aborted before performing any work when it was executed from a reconstructed toolchain that did not ship one of its imported modules.
detail.root_cause: A static top-level ESM import created a hard load-time dependency on a module that the reconstructed toolchain deliberately does not copy, so module resolution failed before the entry point executed.
solution: Replace the static import with a call-time dynamic import so the entry point stays loadable.
Declare the module directory as part of the toolchain the reconstruction copies.
symptoms: Node exited with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND before any update logic ran
No machine-readable result document was produced
The failure occurred identically on every invocation, including dry-run

explanation.was_anything_changed: No. Querying Drupal Knowledge changes nothing.
